reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual third-round review of external-03 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 07 and targeted source-note crop, complete unchanged full native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution returned-note crop, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; earlier review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The dark-eyebrow repair succeeded, but external-03 changes the note to three gray blobs in each of its two rows, six total. The source has two compact source-scale mark groups per row. Reduce each row back to two compact groups while retaining the restored eyebrows and avoiding any third row.
entries.positive_observation: The source-scale dark eyebrows are visibly restored beneath the visor. The olive cap with gold front/visor decoration, covered hair, one restrained closed mouth, smooth chin and absence of added glasses or facial hair remain. The near-frontal slightly viewer-left pose, red/gold collar patches, gold shoulder trim and small central collar/ribbon area remain. The rounded lower head meets a short broad collar. There are exactly two upper note rows, no third row and largely blank lower paper. The complete dark tilted frame, opaque gray-olive backing, cream note and right-edge tab remain, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. The excessive gray groups within those two rows are the remaining rejection reason.
entries.visible_limitations: Very fine upper-lip hair/eyewear, tiny cap/collar symbols and the small central ribbon/pendant construction are not fully legible at source scale; none is an additional rejection reason. The two-versus-three group count in each note row is clearly visible in the source and native return crops.
